# Minut

> Minut is a privacy-first property monitoring platform providing real-time insights through AI-powered sensors and automation for rental properties, short-term rentals, and multifamily portfolios.

Minut serves over 50,000 professionals including hosts, property managers, aparthotel operators, and multifamily teams. The platform combines hardware sensors (M3, water leak detection, cellular gateway) with software features like noise monitoring, smoking detection, occupancy tracking, and automated guest messaging to help property operators manage properties remotely without cameras.

- Noise Monitoring

## Monitoring Features

- [Noise Monitoring](https://www.minut.com/features/noise-monitoring): Real-time noise detection and alerts for rental property compliance
- [Smoking & Marijuana Detection](https://www.minut.com/features/smoking-detection): Instant smoke and marijuana detection to enforce no-smoking policies
- [Occupancy Monitoring](https://www.minut.com/features/occupancy-monitoring): Crowd Detect: Real-time occupancy monitoring to prevent unauthorized gatherings
- [Indoor Climate Monitoring](https://www.minut.com/features/indoor-climate): Temperature and humidity tracking for guest comfort and mold prevention
- [Home Alarm System](https://www.minut.com/features/home-alarm): Home Alarm: Motion and intrusion detection for property security

## Automation & Guest Management

- [Messaging](https://www.minut.com/features/messaging): Minut Messaging: AI-powered guest communication automation for property management
- [Call Assist](https://www.minut.com/features/call-assist): Call Assist: Automated guest notifications for noise and smoke issues
- [Tasks](https://www.minut.com/features/tasks): Minut Tasks: Team collaboration and task management for property operations

## Hardware Sensors

- [M3 Sensor](https://www.minut.com/hardware/m3-sensor): M3 Sensor: Privacy-first hardware for noise, occupancy, and climate monitoring
- [Water Leak Sensor](https://www.minut.com/hardware/water-leak-sensor): L1 Water Leak Sensor: Real-time leak detection to prevent property damage
- [Cellular Gateway](https://www.minut.com/hardware/cellular-gateway): G1 Cellular Gateway: LTE-M connectivity for up to 100 sensors without Wi-Fi
- [HardMount Wired Kit](https://www.minut.com/hardware/hardmount): HardMount: Permanent power solution for continuous sensor operation

## Solutions by Property Type

- [For Hosts](https://www.minut.com/solutions/hosts): Minut for hosts: Real-time monitoring and guest alert automation
- [For Property Managers](https://www.minut.com/solutions/property-managers): Minut for property managers: Multi-property monitoring and automation platform
- [For Multifamily Portfolios](https://www.minut.com/solutions/multi-family): Minut for multifamily: Real-time monitoring and alerts across portfolio
- [For Aparthotels](https://www.minut.com/solutions/aparthotels): Minut for aparthotels: Scalable monitoring across units without added workload
- [For Student Housing](https://www.minut.com/solutions/student-accommodation): Minut for student housing: Party prevention and rule enforcement
